evidence.proved: storage is still billed at USD 6.95/TB/30-days per byte-hour
evidence.quote: Service is billed monthly, based on the amount of data stored per byte-hour over the last month at a rate of $6.95/TB/30-days.

evidence.proved: egress is free up to 3x the average monthly storage
evidence.quote: All B2 Cloud Storage users get free egress up to 3x their average monthly storage.
Egress beyond 3x is just $0.01/GB—no surprise fees, no penalties.

evidence.proved: egress to or through Cloudflare and the other named partners is unlimited and free
evidence.quote: Backblaze B2 offers unlimited free egress when downloading to or through partner content delivery networks (CDNs) and compute services, including Fastly, Cloudflare, bunny.net, CacheFly, CoreWeave, Equinix Metal, Vultr, and phoenixNAP.

evidence.proved: public B2 buckets can be served through Cloudflare's CDN with no Backblaze download fees
evidence.quote: you can store content with Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage and serve it to users using Cloudflare's CDN (Content Delivery Network) with no download fees from Backblaze

evidence.proved: the B2 sign-up page asks for no credit card
account creation verifies the email address by a link
evidence.quote: Check your email, and click the link to verify your email address.

evidence.proved: a public bucket needs a payment history or a small card payment
evidence.quote: Have a payment history on file, or use the credit card form to pay a small fee that is credited to your account balance.
